tools.name: search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Find orders by free text (order number, customer name or email), payment_status, shipment_status and withdrawn, newest first. Returns the order_id that get_order takes. This is the tool for "recent orders", "orders from X", "unpaid orders" (payment_status "pending"), "orders still to ship" (shipment_status "pending") and "orders withdrawn from" (withdrawn true).

keyword.description: Order number, customer name or email.

payment_status.description: Unpaid is "pending". "canceled" is a payment voided with its order; the provider-prefixed codes are PayPal and Stripe card payments.

shipment_status.description: The order's shipments taken together: "pending" is nothing shipped yet.

withdrawn.description: Only the orders a customer withdrew from. Leave it out otherwise; there is no filter for "not withdrawn".

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Everything about one order: line items, totals, addresses, payment and shipment status. order_id comes from search_orders.

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Find products across the catalogue, including disabled and out-of-stock ones that the storefront hides. Returns the SKU that get_product takes.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Everything the admin knows about one product by SKU: price, stock, published state and the variant group it belongs to.

tools.name: low_stock_report
tools.title: Low stock report
tools.description: Products at or below a stock threshold, lowest first. Use it for "what is running out?".

tools.name: search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Find customer accounts by name or email. Returns account details only. For what a customer bought, use search_orders.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer with their saved addresses and whether their account is enabled. Takes the customer_id from search_customers. Never returns credentials.

tools.name: sales_summary
tools.title: Sales summary
tools.description: The shop's lifetime sales totals. Use it for "how are we doing?", not for one order or one period.

tools.name: sales_report
tools.title: Sales report for a period
tools.description: Sales for a period in the shop's time zone: revenue, orders, average order and items sold, the change against the previous period, best and worst sellers by quantity and by revenue, products that sold nothing, and sales by category. Cancelled, fully refunded and test orders are left out (and counted separately). Use it for "what sold best this week?", "how was last month?", "sales today vs yesterday". For lifetime totals use sales_summary.

period.description: Default this_week. Weeks start on Monday. A running period (today, this_week, this_month, this_year) is compared with the same stretch of the one before; last_7_days and last_30_days are whole days before today. custom needs from and to.

from.description: For custom: first day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the shop time zone.

to.description: For custom: last day, included, YYYY-MM-DD.

compare.description: Compare with the previous period. Default true.

limit.description: How many best/worst sellers to list. Default 5.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: The shop's categories, with their parent, url key and whether each is published.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.title: List changes made by the assistant
tools.description: What a connected AI assistant changed in this shop, newest first: the tool, the thing changed, the values before and after, and whether it can be undone. The owner sees the same list in the shop admin under Settings > Changes by the AI assistant, and can undo a change there.

tool.description: Only changes made by this tool.

only_undoable.description: Only changes that can still be undone.

annotations.title: List changes made by the assistant
